findings.title: Most crawled pages expose no navigation region
findings.evidence: 0 of 13 crawled HTML pages contain a <nav> element or role="navigation"; the homepage exposes 22 internal links in total. Navigation was detected structurally (nav landmark plus internal links inside it), so a visually styled menu that uses neither will also be reported here.

suggested_action.summary: Provide a consistent primary navigation region on every page, marked up as a nav landmark.
steps: Wrap the primary menu in a <nav> element present on every template.
Include links to the main sections (offering, pricing, about, contact).
Make sure the links exist in the server-rendered HTML, not only after client-side hydration.

findings.confidence_reason: deterministic rule on measured values; direct DOM/HTTP observation; sample of 13 pages; consistent across 13/13 pages
findings.impact: Without a consistent navigation region, a visitor who lands on an interior page has no reliable way to move to the rest of the site, so the visit usually ends on the landing page.
findings.priority_reason: impact 0.80 (severity high) x reach 1.00 x confidence 0.98 x fixability 0.60

technical_details.observation: 0 of 13 crawled HTML pages contain a <nav> element or role="navigation"; the homepage exposes 22 internal links in total.
technical_details.details: Navigation was detected structurally (nav landmark plus internal links inside it), so a visually styled menu that uses neither will also be reported here.

suggested_action.summary: Remove the noindex directive from pages that are meant to be public.
steps: Confirm each listed page is intended to be publicly discoverable.
Remove the noindex value from the robots meta tag / X-Robots-Tag header.
Keep noindex only on genuinely private or duplicate URLs.

findings.confidence_reason: deterministic rule on measured values; direct DOM/HTTP observation; sample of 5 pages
findings.impact: A noindex directive asks retrieval systems not to keep the page, so its content is unlikely to be surfaced or cited even though it is publicly reachable.

findings.title: No XML sitemap was found
findings.evidence: Neither /sitemap.xml nor any Sitemap: directive in robots.txt returned a usable sitemap. 13 HTML pages were reachable by link following.

suggested_action.summary: Publish an XML sitemap and reference it from robots.txt.
steps: Generate a sitemap listing canonical URLs of the public pages.
Serve it at /sitemap.xml with HTTP 200 and content-type application/xml.
Add a 'Sitemap: https://<host>/sitemap.xml' line to robots.txt.

findings.confidence_reason: deterministic rule on measured values; direct DOM/HTTP observation; sample of 13 pages
findings.impact: Without a sitemap, automated systems must rely entirely on link discovery, so pages that are weakly linked may never be reached.
findings.priority_reason: impact 0.50 (severity medium) x reach 0.50 x confidence 0.90 x fixability 0.90

technical_details.observation: Neither /sitemap.xml nor any Sitemap: directive in robots.txt returned a usable sitemap.

findings.title: 1 page(s) publish structured data that parses but is missing expected properties or contains placeholders
findings.evidence: https://www.adobe.com/: Organization node has no 'name'; Organization node has no 'url' Checked the shape of syntactically valid JSON-LD: expected properties for the declared @type, empty values, and unreplaced template placeholders.

suggested_action.summary: Populate the expected properties for each declared type and remove template placeholders.
steps: Fix the specific properties listed in this finding.
Replace any templating placeholder with the real value at render time.
Validate the corrected blocks against schema.org for their @type.
Add a build-time check so an empty required property fails CI.

findings.confidence_reason: deterministic rule on measured values; direct DOM/HTTP observation; sample of 13 pages
findings.impact: Structured data that lacks its identifying properties gives a consumer nothing to attach the facts to, so the block is published but cannot be used - and a placeholder value can put an outright wrong fact into machine-readable form.
findings.priority_reason: impact 0.50 (severity medium) x reach 0.10 x confidence 0.90 x fixability 0.85
